rubric.statement: The program must define fields with custom `prefix=...` values, capture the warning raised when those fields are declared, and assert that the warning says the `prefix` argument is deprecated and has no effect in DSPy.

The program must prove the prefixes still survive in field metadata by reading `Signature.input_fields[...]` and `Signature.output_fields[...]` and asserting that `json_schema_extra["prefix"]` preserves the custom strings exactly.
The proof must exercise the default `dspy.ChatAdapter` rendering path and inspect both the structured instruction text and the user-side rendered text, rather than stopping at metadata inspection.

The program must assert that the custom prefix strings do not appear in the rendered prompt text, because chat rendering uses `[[ ## field_name ## ]]` markers and field names/values for both the field structure and the user/output-format text instead of the deprecated `prefix` metadata.
The runnable example should print or otherwise surface the captured warnings, the stored prefix metadata, and the rendered prompt text so the stored-but-unused behavior is directly observable.
